description: Plan an audit or a research task. Give your goal, the target and your limits; get back an ordered list of aeogeo tool calls with the quota each costs, which steps are semantic (judge: agent), what was deferred to fit your budget, your tier's daily limits, and the semantic-review rubric for the page type. Deterministic: no inference, no fetch, same input gives the same plan. The semantic review and report steps are never dropped to fit a budget. Use when: You are about to audit a page, a draft or a site, or answer a research question, and want the right calls for your goal, effort and remaining quota. Avoid when: You already know the single tool you need, such as scan_url on one URL. Do not claim: A plan is not a finding. Nothing was scanned or evaluated. Verify: Run the steps in order; the semantic review step is yours to do.

budget.description: Optional limits. calls: tool calls you will spend. rules: rules you can still draw today. pages: site-scan pages left today.

content_type.description: Content type used to select applicable checks.

effort.description: quick (default): fewest calls. standard: two rule lookups. thorough: three, plus insights.

goal.description: fix_errors: engine defects first, cheapest path. pre_publish: lint a draft, then scan after deploy. citation_readiness: adds evidence and changelog lookups. site_audit: whole site, sampled semantic review. research: rulebook questions, no scan.

page_count.description: Pages on the site, when known; sizes the scan_site step.

target_kind.description: What is being audited: a live url, a whole site, draft html, draft text, a json-ld block, or none (research).

name: plan_audit
title: Plan an audit
